verdict.rationale: Lambda publishes a raw OpenAPI JSON spec (lambda-labs-docs-31, lambda-labs-docs-39) but there is no evidence of an interactive API reference UI (e.g., Swagger/Redoc 'try it' console) with runnable examples; probes for interactive docs paths (llms.txt, openapi.json under docs.lambda.ai) return 404s, suggesting no integrated interactive explorer.
